query:
SELECT
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM "RolesOnUsers" ru
                JOIN "RolesOnPermissions" rp ON rp."roleId" = ru."roleId"
                WHERE ru."userId" = $1
                    AND rp."permissionId" = 'read:professional_features'
            ) AS "professional!",
            (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM (
                    SELECT id FROM email_links WHERE macro_id=$1
                    UNION
                    SELECT link_id FROM macro_user_links WHERE primary_macro_id=$1
                ) AS inboxes
            ) AS "inboxes!"
